title: fix(spec): error-code provenance reads a constant by its initializer, and the ledger lists @objectstack/mcp's exposure codes
body:
Fixes #22664
Clause-②: yes

`check:error-code-provenance` recognised a constant only when its NAME ended in `_CODE`. That proxy hid the `@objectstack/mcp` stdio data bridge's two exposure constants, and ten others like them. This PR replaces the name rule with an initializer rule: a declared binding of any name whose literal initializer is a registered code is a stamp site. The ledger gains the `@objectstack/mcp` owner key, and one provenance waiver for a shared constant in `@objectstack/types`. No new gate.

## Step 1: the measurement (repo-wide, before any edit)

**Instrument and radius.** A scratch script (not committed) that walks the gate's own population, `collectSourceFiles` (2849 files at `origin/main` `ee3ae0360d`: `packages/**/src` non-test `.ts`/`.tsx`, the ledger file excluded), masks comments with the gate's own masker, and reads two things:

- every `const|let|var NAME = 'CODE'` declaration (type annotation and `as const` admitted) and every `readonly|static NAME = 'CODE'` class field whose initializer is a registered code, with each binding's in-file references classified by position;
- a census of every registered-code literal in code (708), split into the ones at a site the gate already reports (336, keyed by line and code) and the rest (372), classified by the tokens in front of them.

**Positive control.** The instrument finds all 37 `*_CODE` declarations the gate's `constdef` already reports, each marked as seen.

**Declared constants the gate could not see: 11, in five packages.**

| Package | Constant = code | File | How the binding reaches a stamp | Ledger |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `@objectstack/mcp` | `OBJECT_API_DISABLED` | `stdio-data-bridge.ts:207` | `exposureError(…, OBJECT_API_DISABLED, 404)`, whose body assigns `err.code = code` | **no row** |
| `@objectstack/mcp` | `OBJECT_API_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED` | `stdio-data-bridge.ts:208` | same helper, 405 | **no row** (the card names only the first) |
| `@objectstack/types` | `GLOBAL_UNIQUE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED` = `UNIQUE_SCOPE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED` | `unique-scope-install-gate.ts:336` | imported by `@objectstack/cloud-connection`, stamped `code: GLOBAL_UNIQUE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED` in the install seam's 409 | **no row, no waiver** for types; cloud-connection lists it |
| `@objectstack/plugin-auth` | `SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED`, `EMAIL_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED`, `AUDIENCE_CONFIG_ERROR` = `AUTH_CONFIG_ERROR` | `audience-posture.ts:103/105/107` | `code: CONST` | listed |
| `@objectstack/service-analytics` | `DATASET_INVALID`, `READ_SCOPE_COMPILE_FAILED` (two files) | `dataset-refusal.ts:128`, `read-scope-refusal.ts:88`, `read-scope-sql.ts:677` | `err.code = CONST` | listed |
| `@objectstack/spec` | `CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE`, `PLUGIN_UI_REQUIRED_KEY_MISSING` | `connector-provider-errors.ts:31`, `plugin.zod.ts:157` | `readonly code = CONST`; `code: CONST` | listed |

Every one of the 11 reaches a stamp position. None is a constant that is only compared against, so widening adds no phantom site on this tree. `let`/`var` and lower-case names: zero on this tree.

**The other shapes the brief asked about.**

- **Object map.** One map holds registered codes: `EXTERNAL_ERROR_CODES` in `packages/spec/src/shared/external-errors.ts`, three codes, all listed under `@objectstack/spec`. No miss.
- **Re-exported or imported constant.** Three constants are imported by another package:
  - `@objectstack/types` to `@objectstack/cloud-connection`: a stamp, and cloud-connection lists the code. This is the row in the table above.
  - `@objectstack/metadata-core` to `@objectstack/objectql`: a stamp, listed, with the existing `UPDATE_ID_MISMATCH` waiver.
  - `@objectstack/objectql` to `@objectstack/plugin-sharing`: a `code:` key in a `warn` log payload, not an emission.
  
  So attributing a constant to the package that defines it misses no emission today. The gate's header now declares that bound.
- **Class fields** (`readonly code = 'X'`): 39 sites, all 39 listed. The header declares this shape blind, and it is not widened here (see Acceptance notes).

## Step 2: the one rule

`STAMP_PATTERNS`' `constdef` limb now reads:

- `const|let|var NAME = 'CODE'`, for a binding of any name, with an optional type annotation; and
- the old `X_CODE = 'CODE'` limb, kept for a keyword-less `*_CODE` binding (a class `static readonly`, or a second declarator). This makes the new rule a superset of the old one.

The pattern names stay `objlit`, `assign`, `constdef`. The registered set is still the filter.

**Before and after, whole repo, same tree:**

| Tree | Rule | Files | Sites | `constdef` | Listed | Waived | Violations |
|:--|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| `ee3ae0360d` | old (`*_CODE` name) | 2849 | 337 | 37 | 319 | 18 | 0 |
| `ee3ae0360d` + new pattern, ledger untouched | new | 2849 | 348 | 48 | 327 | 18 | **3** (mcp x2, types x1) |
| merged head `b6ba2fefe6` | old | 2862 | 337 | 37 | 319 | 18 | 0 (plus 1 waiver problem: the new types waiver matches no site, so it cannot outlive the widening) |
| merged head `b6ba2fefe6` | new | 2862 | 348 | 48 | 329 | 19 | 0 |

`b6ba2fefe6` is the merge of `origin/main` `243dd3c625`; its source is identical to the head `de2fedcb76`, which adds only the changeset. The site-set diff on `ee3ae0360d`, before against after: **0 sites lost, 11 added**, exactly the 11 in the table above.

## Step 3: the ledger

- **`'@objectstack/mcp': ['OBJECT_API_DISABLED', 'OBJECT_API_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED']`.** The row comment records the reachability reading. `enforceApiExposure` stamps the code on the thrown `McpExposureError` (404/405) before every stdio data verb and the ADR-0101 record resource. The stdio data tools flatten the throw to its message (`errorResult(messageOf(err))` in `mcp-http-tools.ts`), so no MCP result carries the code today. That makes it a `door: 'none'` row under the ledger's "door or no door" ruling.
- **`PROVENANCE_WAIVERS` gains `@objectstack/types` → `UNIQUE_SCOPE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`, registered under `@objectstack/cloud-connection`.** This is the existing "shared constructor one package over" class, with the same shape as the `UPDATE_ID_MISMATCH` waiver. Types defines the constant, and its one stamp is cloud-connection's install-seam 409, which that package's row already records. Without this entry, the widened gate reds on `main`.

**Lane note.** This ledger change adds another lane's entry (`@objectstack/mcp` is `domain:cli`) and a waiver. Per the spec lane's ledger rule, it owes the seat's contract review before the queue. `packages/mcp/**` is not touched: the widening route needed no rename.

## Pins

- **`--self-test`.** Four new cases:
  - a declared constant of any name is a site;
  - the keyword-less `*_CODE` limb still matches;
  - a re-assignment to an undeclared non-`*_CODE` name is not a site;
  - a comparison is not a site.

  Battery floors were raised from 4 to 6 and from 2 to 4.
- **`check-error-code-provenance.test.ts`:**
  - the widened `constdef` spellings: a bridge-named constant, `export … as const`, `let`, a typed binding;
  - the superset limb;
  - the precision pair;
  - a new block that drives the bridge's two declarations, verbatim, through the scan and the REAL ledger. Both are seen, both are listed, and the red leg runs with the `@objectstack/mcp` key removed: both sites become violations, and no waiver stands in. The block is copied rather than read, so the suite still reads nothing outside its package.
- **The card's pin, run end to end (a one-time ablation, not committed).** The input was the committed tree at `b6ba2fefe6`, clean. `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` deleted the whole `@objectstack/mcp` block from the ledger:
  - the anchor went from 1 to 0, and the blob changed (`bde983d345ac` to `a32024110781`);
  - the real gate then ran (`tsx scripts/check-error-code-provenance.ts`, which imports the ledger from `src/`, with no `dist` on the path) and printed `FAIL — 2 stamp site(s) of a registered code with no provenance row`, naming `stdio-data-bridge.ts:207` and `:208`, exit 1;
  - the restore was proven: the blob after restore equals HEAD (`bde983d345ac`), and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Clause-② (measured on the built declaration closure)

After `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, `dist/error-code-ledger.zod-*.d.ts` declares `readonly '@objectstack/mcp': readonly ["OBJECT_API_DISABLED", "OBJECT_API_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED"]` on `ERROR_CODE_LEDGER`'s type. The published type gains a key, which widens the public face. Other readings:

- `check:api-surface`: `@objectstack/spec public API surface + factory signatures unchanged ✓`. The snapshot records that an export exists, not what it resolves to.
- `check:export-origins`: current (5386 exports across 19 entry points).
- `ErrorCode` and `REGISTERED_ERROR_CODES` are unchanged, because both codes were already registered under `@objectstack/rest`.
- `PROVENANCE_WAIVERS` changes in value only.

The claim's `Clause-②: yes` stands. The changeset is `@objectstack/spec: minor`. There are no type-level consumers of the ledger's key set outside `error-code-ledger.test.ts` (`git grep 'typeof ERROR_CODE_LEDGER'`), and no consumer in objectui.

## Verification (head `de2fedcb76`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2`, then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`, under the verify lock: **642 files passed, 19165 tests passed, 1 todo**. Typecheck passed: `tsc --noEmit`, `check:scripts-typecheck` (its program compiles both the gate and its test, counted with `--listFilesOnly`) and `check:test-typecheck`. Lock verdict: `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:error-code-provenance` (self-test and run): `self-test OK — 3 patterns …; 17 case(s) across 5 batteries`, then `scanned 2862 files; 348 registered-code stamp site(s): 329 listed, 19 waived`, `OK — … (10 waiver(s), all live)`.
- The derived gate list, re-derived at this head with no paths (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 91 commands over the 4 changed files): **all 91 ran and exited 0**. `--ran` reconciliation: `91 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 91 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. One family, the `check:pm-dispatch-gates` battery (fast tier, 1825 cases pass), was recorded without an exit code. The list includes `check:error-code-casing`, `check:strictness-ledger`, `check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary`, `check:api-surface`, `check:export-origins`, `check:docs` (225 generated files in sync), `check:error-status-conformance`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:published-files`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-adr-0087-registration` (1 non-breaking changeset) and `check-empty-changeset`. Three of them first refused with PREREQUISITE NOT MET (unbuilt packages): `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:lean-entry-closure` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`. All three exited 0 after `turbo run build` (73 of 73 tasks, 71 cached).
- Lint, narrowed and proven: eslint `--no-inline-config --format json` over the three changed `.ts` files reported 3 files, 0 errors and 0 warnings, and none was ignored (no "File ignored" message). `eslint.config.mjs` never enables type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot move the verdict on any untouched file. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

## Acceptance notes (observations, not filed)

- **Class fields** (`readonly code = 'X'`) remain a declared blind shape: 39 sites, all 39 listed under their stamping package. Recognising them would add 39 sites and 0 violations. That is a separate widening for a later card. Carrier: none.
- **Helper, ternary and table indirections** stay as the header declares them. The unseen-literal census by context: 212 call or array arguments, 46 comparisons, 27 type positions, 14 ternary or `??` operands, 11 table rows, 9 non-`code` object keys, 7 other. These are raw contexts, not adjudicated stamps: comparisons and types are not emissions, and `z.enum` lists are the vocabulary itself. Some sit in packages that do not list the code, for example plugin-auth's `FORBIDDEN`/`NOT_FOUND` passed to its error helpers. Read-only inference: not filed, and no card was opened. Carrier: none.
